versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the threejs-3d skill.
- Provides a comprehensive Three.js 3D graphics reference for web apps, games, and visualizations.
- Covers key topics: scene setup, cameras, geometries, materials, lights, shadows, post-processing, controls, animation, loaders, textures, node materials, math utilities, and debugging.
- Includes a quick start code example and modular, concise reference files for each topic.
- Designed for practical usage with relevant code patterns and gotchas highlighted.
